claims.finding: GameStop disclosed results of operations under item 2.02 twice in eight days: an 8-K accepted 2026-08-31T06:23:08Z carrying items 1.01, 2.02, 3.02, 7.01 and 9.01 - i.e. preliminary quarterly results bundled with a material agreement and an unregistered sale of equity securities - and then the 8-K accepted 2026-09-08T09:02:39Z carrying only items 2.02, 7.01 and 9.01; the 08-31 disclosure moved the stock +2.85% on 10.95m shares against a 6.20m 20-day average, and the stock then rose a further 7.2% over five sessions to $19.16, so the 9 September print inherits a bid-up tape and almost no headline surprise capacity.
claims.corpus_ref: filings.json accession 0001326380-26-000046 (items 1.01,2.02,3.02,7.01,9.01) versus accession 0001326380-26-000050 (items 2.02,7.01,9.01); tape from quote.json bars 2026-08-28 through 2026-09-04
claims.why_not_priced: The item codes are the whole finding and nobody aggregates them: an earnings calendar shows one date, 8 September, and an implied move sized off this company's 4.79% median reaction. What is actually happening is a pre-release, and the baseline itself only got as far as flagging the cadence as 'suspect' (8 days against a 91-day gap, history_usable 0) without resolving which of the two dates carried the news. If the market had priced the pre-release properly, the five sessions after 08-31 would not have added another 7.2% on 4.8m-11.8m share days into a release with nothing new to say.
claims.independence: Confirmed from a completely different source: the StockTwits digest fetched 2026-09-07T15:08:21Z contains a post at 2026-09-06T11:55:53Z titled 'GME Kills the VWAP early, Q2 prelim results, my trading position update & GME current Fair Value Update' (docs/41a4a7aa3d67072d0008eff3edfb23de89ebd9b6.txt, https://youtu.be/GOOtpiQ2Epo) - retail was already working off preliminary Q2 numbers two days before the scheduled print. The same digest also shows what the print is actually being asked to deliver instead of numbers ('it's monday and there's no buyout announcement', 'we need news this week', 'one of these days Cohen is gonna drop the bomb'), which is a high and non-financial bar.

claims.finding: GameStop raised capital twice in the four weeks before the print - 8-K items 1.01/3.02/8.01/9.01 accepted 2026-08-03T10:12:28Z and items 1.01/2.02/3.02/7.01/9.01 accepted 2026-08-31T06:23:08Z, both carrying item 3.02 unregistered sales of equity securities - while the stock sat within 7.2% of its 52-week low and 30.8% below its 52-week high.
claims.why_not_priced: Two item 3.02 events inside a month is a rate of issuance that does not show up in any summary of the name, and the second one was folded into the same 8-K as the preliminary results, so the financing and the numbers were reported as one story. The tape shows no distinct de-rating on either date, which is what I would expect to see if the dilution had been separately priced.
claims.independence: The StockTwits digest fetched 2026-08-30 independently frames the same risk from the holder side ('will he do another bond dilution for the rest of the 0% interest bonds', 2026-08-28) and reports a 14% rise in Robinhood's borrow rate for GME warrants on 2026-08-28 - a funding-cost signal on the same capital structure. This finding shares the 2026-08-31 8-K with my first finding and should be collapsed into that source cluster; only the 2026-08-03 8-K is genuinely additional.
